agent_prompt:
# Incident triage for production alerts

Before starting, confirm:
- The alert came from the production PagerDuty service, see https://status.example.com/runbooks/triage
- You are the on-call engineer listed in PagerDuty

Follow these steps in order:
1. Acknowledge the alert in PagerDuty within 5 minutes (tool: PagerDuty)
2. Open the service dashboard in Grafana and check error rate and latency for the last 30 minutes (tool: Grafana)
3. Only if error rate exceeds 5 percent: declare a SEV1 in Slack and page the service owner (tool: Slack)
4. Only if error rate is under 5 percent: post a status update in the #incidents Slack channel (tool: Slack)
5. Create the incident ticket in Jira from template INC-77 with the alert link and the dashboard screenshot (tool: Jira)
6. Mitigate using the runbook in doc:runbooks/service-triage
   - expected: error rate back under 1 percent
7. Resolve the PagerDuty alert and link the Jira ticket in the resolution note (tool: PagerDuty)

Never:
- restart the database cluster without the service owner on the call
- close the alert before the Jira ticket exists

Done when:
- The alert is resolved in PagerDuty and the Jira ticket links the timeline
